description_ru: Юмористический рассказ об отпуске в Италии, перепутанном чемодане и встрече с оперной певицей.
text:
Every traveller has a story about a lost suitcase, but I think that mine is the strangest. Two summers ago, I flew to Italy for a week's holiday. I was going to visit my cousin Paolo, eat a lot of pasta and finally see the sea. I packed carefully. I took three T-shirts, a pair of swimming shorts, a good book and a new pair of white trousers that I had bought for the occasion.

The flight was long, and I was very tired when we arrived. At the baggage claim, I stood among a hundred people and watched the suitcases go round and round on the belt. There was a green one, a blue one and a red one with stickers. After a while, I saw a black suitcase that looked like mine. It had the same size, the same wheels and even the same small scratch. I took it quickly and walked to the exit. Paolo was waiting for me with a big smile, and he drove me to his house.

At his house, I opened the suitcase to take out my clothes, and I got a surprise. There were no T-shirts and no swimming shorts. Instead, I found a beautiful long blue dress, three pairs of high-heeled shoes and a large hat with a feather. At the bottom, there was a small box with a pair of earrings. Paolo looked at the things, then at me, and started to laugh. "You have changed your style," he said.

I felt terrible. Somewhere in the city, a woman was opening my suitcase and looking at my swimming shorts. I called the airport and explained the situation. The man on the phone spoke very fast, and I did not understand half of what he said. At the end, he told me that I should wait. "Maybe tomorrow, maybe the day after tomorrow," he said. In Italy, "tomorrow" is a very flexible word.

I had nothing to wear, because I was still in my travel clothes, which smelled like an aeroplane. Paolo gave me some of his clothes, but he was taller and much wider than me. His trousers fell down every time I walked, and his shirt was so big that it looked like a tent. We went to a shop to buy something, but the only things in my size were bright orange. I bought a pair of orange shorts, and Paolo took a photograph. He said that it was a perfect picture for my family.

The next day, I received a call from the airport. The woman who had my suitcase was also at the airport, and she was angry too. We decided to meet in a cafe near the centre. When I arrived, I saw a tall woman in a long red coat. She was holding my suitcase, and she did not look happy. Her name was Francesca, and she was an opera singer. She was going to sing that same evening in a famous theatre, and her dress, her shoes and her earrings were all in my bag.

Francesca had had a terrible day. She had worn my swimming shorts as a joke, and she had read my book from the beginning to the end. "It is very boring," she said. "Nobody has any fun in this story." I said that I was sorry, but she was already laughing. We exchanged suitcases, and she invited me to the concert as a way of apology.

That evening, I put on my white trousers and went to the theatre with Paolo. The music was beautiful, and Francesca sang like an angel. At the end, she bowed and pointed at me in the audience. "This song is for the man with the orange shorts!" she said. A thousand people turned around and looked at me. I wanted to disappear under the seat, but Paolo was clapping with joy. I was wearing the white trousers, and I discovered a large red mark on them. It was from the wine that I had spilled in the interval.

I have travelled a lot since then, but now I always do one thing. I tie a bright yellow ribbon on my suitcase, so that nobody can mistake it for another. And I always put my swimming shorts in my hand luggage. You never know when you are going to need them, or who is going to wear them.

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Губы округлите и вытяните вперёд, зубы не касаются губы. Это не русское «в».
Рот открыт шире, чем для русского «э», язык впереди и внизу.
Долгий «у» с вытянутыми вперёд губами. Не сокращайте.
Долгий звук «и», губы растянуты в улыбке. Не путайте с коротким ɪ: sheep и ship.

questions.question: What did the writer find in the wrong suitcase?
questions.answer: A blue dress, high-heeled shoes, a hat with a feather and earrings.

questions.question: Why did the writer wear orange shorts?
questions.answer: He had no clothes, and the only clothes in his size in the shop were orange.

questions.question: What does the writer do now when he travels?
questions.answer: He ties a bright yellow ribbon on the suitcase and keeps swimming shorts in his hand luggage.
